milestone: Typed architecture-owned native DeepSeek V4.1 numerical configuration
status: Qualified configuration component; whole inference/vLLM goal remains active

implementation.api: bn_model_arch_native_numerics validates atomically; bn_model_prepare_native_numerics publishes a model-owned immutable profile after anatomy and before backend setup; bn_model_native_numerics returns the borrowed const profile.
implementation.settings: F32 norm epsilon 1e-20, HC4 epsilon 1e-6 and 20 Sinkhorn iterations with carry-pre, SiLU clamp10, sqrtsoftplus/noaux_tc normalized routing with scale1.5, main theta10000 and compressed theta160000, YaRN factor16 beta32/1 original65536, token IDs and Engram vocabulary parameters.
implementation.rope: Original main attention is unscaled; compressed attention uses YaRN; attention factor1 and truncate true. These architecture choices are explicit in the typed profile.
implementation.validation: Supported numeric constants compare by exact decimal identity without strtod/locale/global state or runtime floating arithmetic. Equivalent decimal spellings accepted; unsupported, missing, wrong-type or ambiguous settings rejected before publication. Existing config/anatomy/expert catalog remain valid on failure.
implementation.scope: Explicit supported checkpoint policy, not a general decimal-to-float converter or executor admission. Legacy BnConfig/weights unchanged. Unsupported numeric policies/extra RoPE settings require separate implementation/qualification.

validation.source_configuration_capture: Selected unchanged original DeepseekV4Config read_cfg assignments plus DeepseekV41Model carry-pre class constant; Python struct.pack independently gives F32 bits. Main/compressed RoPE choice verified from original dsv4.py and util/rope.py; no numerical RoPE kernel capture.
validation.differential_oracle: Python Decimal exact equality and strict JSON number grammar, including enormous exponent/zero cases, wrong types and near-equal decimal values.
validation.synthetic: All four host rounding modes; seven equivalent norm epsilon forms; unsupported norm/HC/YaRN/router/dropout/dtype/flags/token bounds; rejection preserves output; owned profile before backend publication, one-shot setup and teardown callback lifetime.

diagnostic_warnings.cause: Existing unused static AVX2 helpers in src/moe_cpu_kernels.c under Clang; clean GCC product build has zero warnings.
